source.caption: Quality evaluation of unconditionally generated text. We compare SEDD and GPT-2 by the perplexity of their analytically generated sequences. Our SEDD models consistently outperform GPT-2, interpolating between a $32 \times$ speedup and a $6$-$8\times$ improvement based on the chosen step size. The generated text reflects this improved generation capability, as our samples are far more coherent. Additional samples and ablations can be found in Appendix \ref{app:add:samples}
